gender_identity.definition: Gender identity as stated by the individual.

gender_affirming_hormones.definition: Gender-affirming hormone use as stated in the case.

breast_surgery_status.definition: Breast surgery history relevant to gender-affirming care.

considering_removal_of_all_breast_tissue.definition: Individual is considering removal of all breast tissue.

prostate_present.definition: Individual has a prostate (male organ at risk).

considering_rrso_before_natural_menopaus.definition: Individual is considering risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy before natural menopause.

earlier_gender_dysphoria_surgery_conside.definition: Surgery (RRSO or hysterectomy) at an earlier age than recommended is being considered to alleviate gender dysphoria, with appropriate health care professionals.

family_known_plp_any_cancer_gene.definition: A blood relative has a known P/LP variant in a cancer susceptibility gene (familial variant known).

family_known_tp53_plp.definition: Individual is from a family with a known TP53 P/LP variant.

family_known_pten_plp.definition: Individual is from a family with a known PTEN P/LP variant.

personal_known_plp_breast_cancer_gene.definition: Individual has a known P/LP variant in a breast cancer gene.

history_consistent_with_breast_cancer_pl.definition: Personal or family history is judged by the clinician to be consistent with a breast cancer P/LP variant (clinician judgement).
history_consistent_with_breast_cancer_pl.criteria: personal or family history consistent with a breast cancer P/LP

prior_limited_testing_negative.definition: Individual previously tested negative on limited testing (single gene and/or absent deletion/duplication analysis).

interested_in_multigene_testing.definition: Individual is interested in pursuing multigene testing.

tumor_genomic_plp_variant_gene.definition: Gene of a P/LP variant identified on tumor genomic (tumor-only) testing.

tumor_plp_variant_with_germline_clinical.definition: A tumor P/LP variant has clinical implications if also found in the germline (clinician judgement).
tumor_plp_variant_with_germline_clinical.criteria: A P/LP variant identified on tumor genomic testing that has clinical implications if also identified in the germline

testing_needed_for_systemic_or_surgical_.definition: Germline testing is needed to aid systemic therapy or surgical decision-making (clinician judgement).
testing_needed_for_systemic_or_surgical_.criteria: To aid in systemic therapy and surgical decision-making (eg, PARP inhibitors for breast cancer)

lynch_syndrome_testing_criteria_met.definition: Individual meets Lynch syndrome testing criteria per the NCCN Colorectal, Endometrial, and Gastric guideline (criteria not in this input; clinician judgement).
lynch_syndrome_testing_criteria_met.criteria: Individual who meets Lynch syndrome (LS) testing criteria per NCCN Guidelines for Genetic/Familial High-Risk Assessment: Colorectal, Endometrial, and Gastric

familial_variant_test_result.definition: Result of genetic testing for a specific familial P/LP variant.

multigene_panel_result.definition: Result of germline multigene panel testing.

brca_probability_percent.definition: Estimated probability of a BRCA1/2 P/LP variant from a prior probability model (Tyrer-Cuzick, BRCAPro, CanRisk).

meets_crit2_breast_criteria.definition: Individual meets the breast cancer testing criteria CRIT-2 (not in this input; clinician judgement).

warrants_germline_evaluation_clinician_d.definition: Clinical scenario warrants germline evaluation per clinician discretion (clinician judgement).
warrants_germline_evaluation_clinician_d.criteria: clinical scenario not meeting these criteria but warranting germline evaluation per clinician discretion

ashkenazi_jewish_ancestry.definition: Individual is of Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry.

personal_any_cancer.definition: Individual has any personal history of cancer (affected); false means unaffected.

personal_breast_cancer_age_years.definition: Age at diagnosis of personal breast cancer.

personal_epithelial_ovarian_cancer.definition: Personal history of epithelial ovarian cancer, including fallopian tube or peritoneal cancer, at any age.

personal_nonepithelial_ovarian_cancer.definition: Personal history of non-epithelial ovarian cancer (sex-cord tumors with annular tubules, or small cell carcinoma of the ovary, hypercalcemic type).

personal_exocrine_pancreatic_cancer.definition: Personal history of exocrine pancreatic cancer, including acinar cell carcinoma.

personal_neuroendocrine_pancreatic_tumor.definition: Personal history of a neuroendocrine pancreatic tumor.

personal_prostate_cancer_age_years.definition: Age at diagnosis of personal prostate cancer.

prostate_stage_group.definition: Prostate cancer stage group (node-positive Stage IVA, metastatic Stage IVB).

prostate_risk_group.definition: Prostate cancer risk group as assigned in the case per Initial Risk Stratification (PROS-2); the criteria are not in this input.

prostate_intraductal_or_cribriform_histo.definition: Prostate cancer has intraductal or cribriform histology.

prostate_gleason_score.definition: Gleason score of the prostate cancer.

biochemical_recurrence_prostate.definition: Individual has biochemical recurrence of prostate cancer.

personal_serous_endometrial_cancer.definition: Personal history of serous endometrial cancer.

personal_sarcoma_age_years.definition: Age at diagnosis of personal sarcoma.

personal_lfs_spectrum_tumor_count.definition: Number of personal tumors from the Li-Fraumeni spectrum (soft tissue sarcoma, osteosarcoma, CNS tumor, breast cancer, adrenocortical carcinoma); multiple breast tumors count as one.

personal_first_cancer_age_years.definition: Age at diagnosis of the first personal cancer of any type.

personal_adrenocortical_carcinoma.definition: Personal history of adrenocortical carcinoma at any age.

personal_choroid_plexus_carcinoma.definition: Personal history of choroid plexus carcinoma at any age.

personal_embryonal_anaplastic_rhabdomyos.definition: Personal history of rhabdomyosarcoma of embryonal anaplastic subtype at any age.

personal_pediatric_hypodiploid_all.definition: Personal history of pediatric hypodiploid acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

personal_malignant_phyllodes_tumor.definition: Personal history of malignant phyllodes tumor.

personal_adult_lhermitte_duclos.definition: Personal history of adult Lhermitte-Duclos disease (cerebellar tumor).

personal_csphts_clinical_criteria_met.definition: Individual meets clinical diagnostic criteria for Cowden syndrome/PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome (clinician judgement).
personal_csphts_clinical_criteria_met.criteria: Individual meeting clinical diagnostic criteria for CS/PHTS

personal_csphts_major_criteria_count.definition: Number of major criteria for Cowden syndrome/PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome present in the individual's personal history (clinician-counted from the case).

personal_csphts_minor_criteria_count.definition: Number of minor criteria for Cowden syndrome/PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome present in the individual's personal history (clinician-counted from the case).

fam_any_cancer_relatives_count.definition: Count of close blood relatives with any cancer.

fam_first_degree_cancer_youngest_age_yea.definition: Youngest age at cancer diagnosis among first-degree relatives.

fam_breast_cancer_count.definition: Count of close blood relatives with breast cancer.

fam_breast_cancer_youngest_age_years.definition: Youngest age at breast cancer diagnosis among close blood relatives.

fam_male_breast_cancer_count.definition: Count of close blood relatives with male breast cancer.

fam_ovarian_cancer_count.definition: Count of close blood relatives with ovarian cancer.

fam_first_or_second_degree_epithelial_ov.definition: Count of first- or second-degree blood relatives with epithelial ovarian cancer (including fallopian tube or peritoneal cancer) at any age.

fam_pancreatic_cancer_count.definition: Count of close blood relatives with pancreatic cancer.

fam_first_degree_pancreatic_cancer_count.definition: Count of first-degree relatives with pancreatic cancer.

fam_prostate_cancer_count.definition: Count of close blood relatives with prostate cancer of any grade.

fam_prostate_metastatic_or_node_positive.definition: Count of close blood relatives with metastatic (Stage IVB) or node-positive (Stage IVA) prostate cancer.

fam_prostate_very_high_or_high_risk_coun.definition: Count of close blood relatives with very high-risk or high-risk prostate cancer (See Initial Risk Stratification and Staging Workup [PROS-2] - NCCN Guidelines for Prostate Cancer).

fam_prostate_intermediate_intraductal_co.definition: Count of close blood relatives with intermediate-risk prostate cancer with intraductal or cribriform histology.

fam_colorectal_cancer_count.definition: Count of close blood relatives with colorectal cancer.

fam_breast_or_prostate_same_side_count.definition: Count of close blood relatives on the same side of the family with breast or prostate cancer, including the patient if the patient has prostate cancer.

fam_same_lineage_cancer_under45_count.definition: Count of first- or second-degree relatives in the same lineage diagnosed with cancer under age 45.

fam_same_lineage_sarcoma_count.definition: Count of first- or second-degree relatives in the same lineage diagnosed with sarcoma at any age.

fam_lfs_spectrum_youngest_age_years.definition: Youngest age at diagnosis of a first- or second-degree relative with a Li-Fraumeni spectrum cancer.

fam_lfs_spectrum_nonbreast_youngest_age_.definition: Youngest age at diagnosis of a first- or second-degree relative with a Li-Fraumeni spectrum cancer other than breast cancer.

fam_lfs_spectrum_multiple_primary_count.definition: Count of first- or second-degree relatives with multiple primary Li-Fraumeni spectrum tumors.

fam_pediatric_hypodiploid_all.definition: Family history of pediatric hypodiploid acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

fam_untested_deceased_relative_meets_cri.definition: A first- or second-degree untested deceased blood relative meets the family criteria (clinician-stated).
fam_untested_deceased_relative_meets_cri.criteria: Individual with a first-degree or second-degree untested, deceased blood relative meeting any of the criteria listed above

fam_relative_criteria_only_for_systemic_.definition: The relatives meet criteria only for systemic therapy decision-making (clinician-stated).
fam_relative_criteria_only_for_systemic_.criteria: unaffected individuals whose relatives meet criteria only for systemic therapy decision-making

increased_hereditary_risk_clinician_judg.definition: Clinician judges that the individual (transgender woman) is at increased hereditary risk (clinician judgement).
increased_hereditary_risk_clinician_judg.criteria: transgender women at increased hereditary risk

values: Breast, Ovarian, Pancreatic, and Prostate Cancer Genetic Assessment
guideline_section.definition: Which disease or subtype section of this guideline the case belongs to: the disease named in the guideline's page headings that the patient has (e.g. the tumor type or subtype).

brca_probability_band.definition: Band of the model-estimated BRCA1/2 P/LP probability, using the CRIT-3 thresholds.

lfs_classic_criteria_met.definition: Classic Li-Fraumeni criteria: sarcoma diagnosed under 45, a first-degree relative diagnosed with cancer under 45, and an additional first- or second-degree relative in the same lineage with cancer under 45 or sarcoma at any age.

lfs_chompret_criteria_met.definition: Chompret criteria for Li-Fraumeni syndrome testing.

lfs_chompret_t2_criteria_met.definition: Chompret criterion 2: individual with a tumor from the LFS tumor spectrum diagnosed under 46, AND at least one first- or second-degree relative diagnosed with an LFS spectrum cancer at age under 56 or with multiple primaries at any age, where a relative's breast cancer does not count if the proband has breast cancer.

lfs_testing_criteria_met.definition: Any Li-Fraumeni testing criterion is met (known TP53 P/LP family variant, classic LFS, Chompret, or pediatric hypodiploid ALL).

tumor_tp53_germline_discretion_met.definition: Germline testing should be considered for an individual with cancer and a P/LP TP53 variant identified on tumor-only genomic testing whose clinical scenario does not meet the LFS testing criteria but warrants germline evaluation per clinician discretion.

csphts_testing_criteria_met.definition: Cowden syndrome/PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome testing criteria are met.

csphts_alternative_criteria_met.definition: Individual not meeting clinical diagnostic criteria for Cowden syndrome/PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome but with a personal history of one of the listed alternatives (Lhermitte-Duclos, autism with macrocephaly, two or more biopsy-proven trichilemmomas, major and minor criteria counts).

csphts_testing_criteria_with_alternative.definition: Cowden syndrome/PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome testing criteria are met, including the not-meeting-clinical-criteria alternatives.

crit1_general_criteria_met.definition: General testing criteria (CRIT-1): a clinically indicated scenario based on blood relatives, personal or family history of a listed cancer, or a hereditary syndrome criterion.

crit1_listed_criteria_met.definition: Any of the scenarios listed under 'Testing is clinically indicated' on CRIT-1 that are encoded as criteria: CRIT-1 general criteria, a tumor P/LP variant with germline clinical implications, or testing needed for systemic or surgical decision-making.

crit1_limited_negative_multigene_met.definition: Individuals meeting the CRIT-1 criteria who tested negative with previous limited testing and are interested in pursuing multigene testing.

ashkenazi_without_additional_risk_factor.definition: Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry without other risk factors (no general CRIT-1 criteria, no personal cancer, no relative with cancer).

crit4_criteria_met.definition: Ovarian cancer entry criteria: general CRIT-1 criteria, or personal epithelial or non-epithelial ovarian cancer.

crit4_family_history_criteria_met.definition: Ovarian cancer family-history-only criterion: an individual unaffected with ovarian cancer who has a first- or second-degree blood relative with epithelial ovarian cancer (including fallopian tube or peritoneal cancer) at any age.

crit4_criteria_with_family_history_met.definition: Ovarian cancer entry criteria including the family-history-only clause: crit4_criteria_met, or crit4_family_history_criteria_met.

crit5_criteria_met.definition: Pancreatic cancer entry criteria: general CRIT-1 criteria, personal exocrine pancreatic cancer, or first-degree relative with pancreatic cancer.

fam_prostate_advanced_or_high_risk_count.definition: At least one close blood relative with metastatic, node-positive, very high-risk or high-risk prostate cancer.

crit6_t3_relative_criteria_met.definition: At least one close blood relative with breast cancer at age 50 or younger, male breast cancer, ovarian cancer, pancreatic cancer, or metastatic, node-positive, very high-risk or high-risk prostate cancer.

crit6_family_criteria_met.definition: Prostate entry family criteria: a first- or second-degree relative meets the listed criteria (3 or more same-side relatives with prostate or breast cancer, or the relative criteria above); unaffected individuals whose relatives meet criteria only for systemic therapy decision-making are excluded.

crit6_personal_prostate_criteria_met.definition: Personal history of prostate cancer at any age with metastatic or node-positive disease, very high-risk or high-risk disease, Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry, or family history criteria (at least one close blood relative with the listed cancers, or 3 or more close blood relatives with prostate and/or breast cancer on the same side of the family including the patient).

crit6_criteria_met.definition: Prostate cancer entry criteria: metastatic or node-positive disease, high or very high-risk disease, Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry, relative criteria, family criteria, or biochemical recurrence.

any_entry_testing_criteria_met.definition: Any entry-level testing criteria (CRIT-1, CRIT-4, CRIT-5, CRIT-6, CRIT-7 or CRIT-8) are met.

intact_ovaries_and_tubes_present.definition: Individual has one or both intact ovaries and fallopian tubes.

transgender_women_at_increased_hereditar.definition: Male sex at birth: transgender women at increased hereditary risk.

notes.predicates: Conditions were drafted and reviewed by a language model (model_reviewed), not by clinicians. 'rejected' means the review rejected the draft; the box then needs clinician judgement. 'section_only' means the box only requires the patient to be in the page's guideline section.
notes.coordinates: bbox and line_bboxes are PDF points with the origin at the page's top left; pages[].size gives the page size.
notes.links: page links name a page id from pages[]; a multi-page code such as PROS-F has ids 'PROS-F 1 of 5' ... ; external_guideline links name another guideline's slug.
